description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우체국 펀드상품 정보조회 서비스 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 현재 우체국에서 판매하고 있는 펀드상품에 관한 정보입니다. 해당 데이터가 보유한 컬럼은 다음과 같습니다. 컬럼명: 유형구분, 펀드번호, 펀드상품명, 위험등급, 단말신규가능여부, 인터넷신규가능여부, 개인개설가능여부, 법인개설가능여부 우체국 펀드 상품은 일반적인 금융기관의 펀드와 마찬가지로 고객의 투자 자... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 경제경영, 거시경제, 금융(화폐)경제, 전문가관리, 집합투자. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-08-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
